meta.name: review-work
meta.description: Post-implementation gate review: run manual QA on the real surface yourself, then launch ONE gate reviewer (never a panel) to audit goal, constraints, code quality, security, missed context, and QA evidence. Use before a PR handoff or when the user explicitly asks to review completed work.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自查并单审已完成工作，核验目标、质量与安全
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你刚完成功能开发，想在提交PR前做一次独立的把关审查。
copy.tagline_en: Gate-check completed work with a single reviewer before handoff.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you've just finished coding and want an independent check before a PR handoff.

howto.what: 它先在真实运行界面亲手做一轮手动 QA，再派一个“门禁审查”子代理，对照目标与约定检查代码质量、安全性、遗漏的上下文和 QA 证据。QA 只要有一项失败就报告失败；全部通过且子代理批准才算通过。
howto.when: 当你明确要求审查或验收刚完成的工作时；也用于把 PR（代码合并请求）交接给别人之前。

say.text: 我刚写完这段改动，请验收是否达标。
say.note: 它会先在真实运行界面自己跑测试，再下结论。

say.text: 帮我给当前分支做一次门禁审查，排除遗漏与安全隐患。
say.note: 用于代码合并/交接前的整体把关。

say.text: 这个 PR 要交了，先做完整审查再交给别人。
say.note: 它会先做手工 QA，再启动唯一的门禁审查子代理。

howto.what_en: Claude runs manual QA on the real surface, then launches one gate-reviewer subagent to check goal, constraints, code quality, security, missed context, and QA evidence. It passes only with zero failed QA rows and an APPROVE from the reviewer.
howto.when_en: Use before a PR handoff or when the user explicitly asks to review completed work.

say_en.text: Please review the work I just finished and tell me if it meets the goal.
say_en.note: Claude will run manual QA itself first.

say_en.text: Run a gate review on this branch for missed context and security risks.
say_en.note: A single gate reviewer audits the whole change.

say_en.text: This PR is ready. Do a full gate review before I hand it off.
say_en.note: It validates, then launches the gate reviewer.
